frontendNotes: Use the rewritten __PORT_5300__ preview base with /api paths. For normal same-origin hosting use an empty API base.
Keep the login token only in JavaScript memory. Use credentials: omit. Never put a token in a URL.
Render all inquiry strings as plain text, not innerHTML.
Create a random UUID submissionId once per form attempt and reuse it when retrying after a network error. Generate a fresh ID only for a new inquiry.
Do not claim an email, SMS, booking, callback deadline, or estimate was sent or confirmed.
The server must start after the Astro production build because it indexes only the built static files.

GET /api/health.notes: No database path, version, counts, credentials, or customer data.

request.name: required string, 1–120 characters
request.email: optional valid email string, at most 254 characters
request.phone: optional telephone string, at most 40 characters, 7–20 digits with common formatting
request.projectType: required string, 1–120 characters; not an enum
request.budget: optional string, at most 120 characters; not an enum
request.timeline: optional string, at most 120 characters; not an enum
request.details: required string, 1–5000 characters; line breaks allowed
request.website: optional honeypot string, normally empty, at most 200 characters
request.submissionId: optional 8–128 character idempotency key matching [A-Za-z0-9._:-]+; UUID recommended

rules: At least email OR phone is required.
Unknown fields, null/non-string text fields, arrays, malformed JSON, compressed bodies, and bodies exceeding 16 KiB are rejected with 400.
All strings are trimmed and normalized. Optional text fields can be omitted or sent as empty strings.
A nonempty website honeypot returns the same generic success shape but creates no record.
A valid repeated submissionId returns the original reference with 201 without duplicating or overwriting the inquiry.
submissionId is stored only as a SHA-256 digest and is not returned in the inbox.

response201.message: Your project inquiry has been received.

response429.message: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.

POST /api/inquiries.rateLimit: 20 attempts per client per 15 minutes and 300 total per 15 minutes; Retry-After seconds on 429. Limits include invalid, honeypot, and repeated submissions.

POST /api/admin/login.authentication: Username and password; no existing token required

response401.message: The username or password is incorrect.

POST /api/admin/login.rateLimit: 8 attempts per client, 30 per normalized username, and 120 overall per 15 minutes; generic 429 with Retry-After.

GET /api/admin/inquiries.notes: Newest first. There is no unauthenticated list, lookup, status, delete, or export endpoint.

response200.inquiry: updated inquiry object in the GET format

POST /api/admin/logout.notes: Revokes the current token immediately. Missing, expired, or revoked tokens produce 401.

commonResponse401.message: Please sign in to the website inbox.

corsAndSecurity.origins: Same origin, configured ALLOWED_ORIGINS, and opaque Origin: null when ALLOW_OPAQUE_ORIGIN=true (default for preview).
corsAndSecurity.credentials: No cookies; no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. All private APIs require bearer authentication.
corsAndSecurity.preflight: OPTIONS /api/* returns 204 for supported methods and headers without authentication or quota consumption.
corsAndSecurity.storage: No IP, raw body, user agent, plaintext password, or plaintext session token is stored in the database. Application code does not log payloads.
corsAndSecurity.limiting: Client addresses are used transiently and converted to process-salted HMAC keys in bounded memory. Limits are single-process and reset on restart.
corsAndSecurity.sessions: Random 256-bit tokens, HMAC-salted digests stored server-side, 8-hour default absolute expiry, logout revocation, maximum 20 concurrent sessions.
corsAndSecurity.static: Only a safe allowlist of real files inside dist is served. Dotfiles, source files, database files, private folders, source maps, and symlinks are excluded. Directory routes redirect to their trailing slash. Missing routes have a real 404, not a homepage fallback.
corsAndSecurity.indexing: X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow,noarchive is on by default. Admin/inbox/API routes remain noindex even if production preview noindex is disabled.

configuration.DATA_DIR: /home/user/workspace/apex-website-private/data by default; must be outside repository and dist. Set an absolute private persistent volume path in production.
configuration.ADMIN_ACCESS_FILE: /home/user/workspace/apex-website-private/Website Inbox Access.md by default; must be outside repository and dist; first bootstrap writes with mode 0600.
configuration.ADMIN_USERNAME: moud by default; used ONLY if no admin exists yet.
configuration.ADMIN_PASSWORD: Optional 8–128 character initial password. If omitted, a cryptographically random password is generated. Used ONLY if no admin exists yet.
configuration.PREVIEW_NOINDEX: true by default. Set false only when ready for intentional production indexing and review the built robots/meta tags too.
configuration.ALLOW_OPAQUE_ORIGIN: true by default for the sandbox preview. Set false in production unless an opaque iframe is explicitly required.
configuration.ALLOWED_ORIGINS: Comma-separated exact HTTPS frontend origins, if hosting the frontend separately.
configuration.TRUST_PROXY: false by default. Set only to a known proxy hop count or explicit trusted networks; never blindly trust forwarded client headers.

operations.passwordRotation: Stop the website server. Run node server/rotate-password.mjs --confirm. It generates a fresh password, updates the private access file, revokes all sessions, and preserves inquiries. Alternatively supply NEW_ADMIN_PASSWORD securely through the environment, not command arguments. Restart afterward.
operations.durability: SQLite persists across process restarts in this sandbox. The sandbox preview is not production hosting or a durability guarantee. Production needs a persistent private volume, HTTPS, backup/restore procedures, access controls, and a retention policy.
operations.notifications: No email or SMS is sent. No external service or existing property-renovation portal is accessed.
operations.backup: Use SQLite's online backup mechanism or stop the server before copying the database. Do not copy only a live database while ignoring its WAL. Store encrypted backups outside public build files.
operations.logging: The application logs only startup/shutdown configuration outcomes. Hosting/proxy access logs require a separate privacy review.
